title: The Composer Is the Page
thesis: From search-your-name to claim, the first screen of each step is one field; value appears in the conversation, not in chrome around it.

light: Flat, quiet surface; at most one soft glow behind the active field to say 'start here'.
composition: One centred composer per step; suggestions sit as chips directly beneath it.
Auth is a short centred stack of provider choices with no marketing around it.
type: One question as the headline at UI-large scale; placeholder text does the teaching.
motion: Zero layout shift as tokens stream; the composer never jumps (DESIGN.md /start canonical example).
Step changes cross-fade on the subtle tier.
color: Neutral surface; the accent only on the primary action and focus ring (focus blue never rotates).

tokenMap.jovie: ChatInput on /start with constant child structure (Layout Shift Prevention)
existing chip/pill primitives at 28px; no new component
subtle tier 150ms; cinematic only for the profile reveal

antiGoals: A marketing hero on any golden-path step.
Copying a reference's composer chrome, icons or suggestion copy.
Status words where a glyph would do.
decidedBy: refs agent, provisional (taste feedback rides post-ship review, JOV-7081)
